prose.subject: URGENT: Payment Route Update for INV-29901 - NEAR Payout
prose.body:
Hi Sofia,

Apologies for the late notice, but our finance team has migrated our primary NEAR payout destination to a new multisig cluster to consolidate our treasury operations effective immediately.

To ensure the upcoming settlement for invoice INV-29901 (amounting to 7633.42 USDC) clears without delay, please direct the payment to our new receiving address: fm-invoices.testnet.

We experienced a minor latency issue with our previous endpoint, so this switch is essential for processing today’s batch. Our ops team has already updated the backend configurations, but we need your confirmation that the transaction is initiated to the new address to avoid any manual review holds on your end.

Please let me know once the transfer is queued so I can monitor the network congestion from our side. If you require the updated remittance memo, just say the word.

Best regards,
Rafael Ferro
Head of Financial Operations
Fennick Media
